Furthermore, due to scheduling restrictions, exactly one of the following two connections must be incorporated into the inspection circuit: the link between Beta and Gamma, or the link between Gamma and Delta.

The objective is to determine the most efficient closed-loop itinerary that visits every substation precisely once, commencing and concluding at the same facility, while minimizing the total travel distance.
